messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported missing rows when they export audit logs with page_size=1000 + sampling enabled. Happens only when KMS signing is on. Anyone seen this?

alex: hmm, can you paste the export filters/params?

maria: filter: team:acct123, event_type: 'model.deploy', time_range: last_30d, page_size=1000, page=3, sampling=true, format=csv

samir: @maria can you paste a tiny CSV snippet (first few lines) and the console version?

maria: pasted a 10-line snippet inline (customer redacted):
"id,event,time,actor,notes"
"...",...
(looks like rows 2501-2600 were missing)
console build: 2026.02.14

kevin: quick hypothesis: sampling was applied before pagination in the exporter pre-change. We merged a reorder in #eng-runtime last month to reduce memory, which could change counts when KMS chunking breaks streams. :thinking_face:

sec-oncall: assigning to security triage. @samir @kevin can you determine if events are permanently lost or just omitted from the exported page? We need impact and repro.

alex: service logs (export-service): `WARN export: page_size shrunk due to kms-chunking, requested=1000, emitted=840, reason=chunk-boundary`

maria: from customer trace: export returned 840 rows for page=3 but console showed 1000 expected. They noticed duplicates across pages too.

audit-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-432 — audit-export-rows-missing — severity: medium — tags: kms, export, sampling

samir: quick repro steps I used: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/audit/export?team=acct123&event=model.deploy&page_size=1000&page=3&sampling=true&format=csv" -o out.csv
wc -l out.csv
```
Result: 841 lines (840 events + header).

kevin: workaround for customers: set sampling=false OR reduce page_size <= 250. We'll add this to KB short-term.

alex: perms angle: noticed a second class of failures — some customers with only `audit_viewer` role get a 403 when exporter calls KMS sign endpoint because the service principal used by exporter isn't allowed to decrypt/sign under cross-account configs. That causes the exporter to abort and yield partial content.

sec-oncall: action items (short):
1) triage cause: sampling+kms chunking ordering bug (assigned @kevin)
2) add robust checks: exporter should detect chunk mismatch and fail with clear error rather than silently shrinking pages (assigned @samir)
3) RBAC doc: clarify service principal perms for KMS signing in cross-account and dedicated/private installs (assigned @alex)
4) console UX: show banner when sampling+KMS+large page_size are used; offer suggested workaround and link to KB (assigned @maria)

samir: will open a PR to change exporter behavior: if emitted_rows < requested_rows then return HTTP 409 with body `{error: "export_truncated_by_kms"}` and metric `export.rows_requested` vs `export.rows_returned`. PR will include unit test for chunked streams.

kevin: estimated timeline: 2d to code + tests, 1d for canary + rollout. If we need fast mitigation we can force exporter to reject sampling=true when KMS signing enabled (feature-flagged).

maria: UX ask for product: instead of failing hard, product might prefer a clear inline banner and an extra column `__sampling_applied=true` in CSV so customers know why rows differ. Also add row counts in the UI export modal. @product please advise.

product-bot: pinged @product for decision on banner vs fail-fast.

alex: on RBAC docs: I'll add a small section showing the required service principal IAM policy for KMS signing and a minimal repro for private deployments. Also will add an example debug command to fetch exporter logs and KMS responses.

sec-oncall: mitigation plan for customers: 1) surface ticket to affected customers with workaround (set sampling=false or reduce page_size), 2) offer one-off export by support if they need full snapshot, 3) schedule patch and KB update.

maria: noted. I'll create a short KB and a console banner draft. Will attach screenshots once I have the UI mock. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin: also adding metric alert: if `export.rows_returned` / `export.rows_requested` < 0.9 for >5% of exports -> create paged-alert for onboarded teams.

samir: PR linked in 10m. Follow-ups: update postmortem if we see customer impact beyond sampling.

maria: resolving this thread for now — tracking in INC-2026-432. Will post patch and KB links when available.
